name: New Reborn
source:
Welcome to the world of New Reborn!

"Enter the world of New Reborn, where a young man with a normal life finds himself mysteriously transported to another world through the isekai genre, where he meets several seductive and charismatic female characters. But the most interesting, he is not the protagonist of this world!

Initially fascinated and frightened by the flawless facade of this new realm, the protagonist soon discovers a profound revelation that makes him question whether this was a good thing.

Was his transfer to this new world the result of a higher purpose, or a mere stroke of bad luck? With time as the sole arbiter, only the protagonist and you can, unravel the truth and discover what fate has in store for him."

[From [url=https://diassmirror.itch.io/new-reborn]Itch.io[/url]]
translation:
欢迎来到《New Reborn》的世界！

“走进《New Reborn》的世界：一名原本过着平凡生活的青年，如同异世界题材故事中的情节那样，神秘地穿越到了另一个世界，并遇见了几位妩媚迷人、各具魅力的女性角色。但最有意思的是，他并不是这个世界的主角！

起初，这个新世界完美无瑕的表象让他既着迷又恐惧。可不久后，主人公就发现了一个重大的真相，让他不禁怀疑，这次穿越究竟算不算好事。

他来到这个新世界，是为了某个更高的使命，还是纯粹倒了霉？唯有时间能够给出裁决，也唯有主人公和你，才能揭开真相，发现命运为他安排了什么。”

（摘自[url=https://diassmirror.itch.io/new-reborn]itch.io[/url]）
